## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) and credit stress rising via HYG (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -1.54%) / LQD (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND — two independent confirmations of risk aversion.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear elevated: VIX (1W: +8.74% | 1M: +21.92%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND with VXX in CORRECTION (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%). Credit stress: HYG/LQD showing widening (HYG (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND). Rates moving up: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -1.40%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
SPY/TLT in RECOVERY (1W: +0.68% | 1M: -0.10%) → mixed but fragile; Dollar strength rising (Level +1.57% 1W | +3.99% 1M) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND is tightening conditions. Credit spread (Level 0.7322) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND confirms tougher funding backdrop.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) and broad oil ETFs USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities holding up: XLU (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +5.80%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -4.32%) — style: defensive tilt.

**5. US vs Global?**
US weaker but less broken: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%); Europe FEZ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -9.50%); China FXI in RECOVERY (1W: +1.17% | 1M: -8.18%) but still structurally weak.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Risk-off tone: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.93%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -0.87%). Crypto shows resilience: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.59% | 1M: +5.43%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil/energy strength dominates: PDBC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.58% | 1M: +18.22%) while copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) signals industrial softness. Gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -1.45%) in short-term selling.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) with BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) and USO ABOVE TREND — natural gas UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +2.60%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Equities and duration weakening — SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -1.40%) validate risk-off. MINOR divergence: VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) and several 1W/1M mismatches (FXI, SOXX, TAN) — watch for momentum turnover but no MAJOR core divergence.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor defensive energy and utilities exposure (XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND; XLU (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +5.80%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broad cyclicals and small caps (IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.93%)) while monitoring credit via HYG/LQD and VIX.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Financials XLF (sector weak; Financials 1W: -3.13% | 1M: -9.44%) BELOW TREND and Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (sector 1W: -3.17% | 1M: -6.59%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) and BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper CPER (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND and silver SLV (1W: -4.28% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VIX ~35 (1W: +8.74% | 1M: +21.92%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND (elevated fear); HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7322 ↑ rising ABOVE TREND (credit stress gauge); XLK/XLF 2.7981 (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.90%) → flat ABOVE TREND as a style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) and HYG/LQD showing credit stress (HYG (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -1.54%) / LQD (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.95%)) confirm the tone. Energy and Utilities showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%); XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +5.80%)), while elevated VIX/VXX divergence (VIX 1W: +8.74% | VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%)) is the key risk signal to monitor.
